没有车，也能把北湾安排成舒服的一天。第一次建议把目的地缩小到 Sausalito: You can enjoy a comfortable North Bay day without a car. For a first trip, keep your destination to the area around the Sausalito ferry dock. The boat ride is part of the day; once there, walk, eat, and watch the water without rushing into the hills. This is a small North Bay waterfront outing, not a tour of all Marin County.
先选回程，再订当天的节奏: Choose your return ferry before planning the day's pace
从 Golden Gate Ferry 的官方时刻表选择 Sausalito—S: Select Sausalito–San Francisco on Golden Gate Ferry's official schedule. Check outbound and return times, the weekday or weekend/holiday version, and service alerts. This guide starts and ends at San Francisco's Ferry Building. Don't show up at another operator's dock just because it has a boat to Sausalito. Use your chosen operator's ticketing and boarding information.
选一班计划回程，并看看之后是否还有可接受的备选，不要默认末班之后仍有船。把到家所: Choose a planned return sailing and check for an acceptable later backup. Don't assume another boat will run after the last scheduled sailing. Include land connections needed to get home. Allow at least half an hour for finding the dock, lining up, and giving companions a rest. This is planning buffer time, not the operator's boarding cutoff.
抵达后，先在码头附近停下来: After arriving, pause near the dock
下船先认清回程候船区域，再到旁边的 Gabrielson Park。市政府页面确: After disembarking, locate the return boarding area before visiting nearby Gabrielson Park. The city confirms that it sits beside the ferry terminal and has lawns, benches, and picnic tables, making it a useful meeting and rest spot. Have water, enjoy the bay, and decide how far you feel like walking. A park suitable for resting does not mean an event is taking place there.
主路线：广场、小公园、再回到水边: Main route: A plaza, a small park, then back to the water
从渡轮广场经 Tracy Way 步行空间走到 Viña del Mar Par: Walk from the ferry plaza through the Tracy Way pedestrian area toward Viña del Mar Park, take a short stroll along nearby Bridgeway, then return the same way to the ferry plaza and Gabrielson Park. This is a small loop around the dock, not a long coastal walk. Check the walking connection between Tracy Way and the park in Sausalito's ferry landing improvement project information.
建议上午乘船抵达，中午在近处按自己的预算吃饭，下午留给一段不赶时间的散步。每次离: Consider arriving by ferry in the morning, eating nearby at lunchtime within your budget, and leaving the afternoon for an unhurried walk. Before heading farther from the dock, check how far you'll need to return. Turn back whenever you reach a place you're happy to stop. If you want a longer walk, a bike rental, or a trip uphill, reassess energy and transportation rather than treating another destination as an automatic extension.
想去 Muir Woods，就另做一份行程: Make a separate plan for Muir Woods
Muir Woods 不是下船后沿海边顺路走到的景点。国家公园管理局说明接驳车有: Muir Woods is not a waterfront stop you can simply walk to after leaving the ferry. The National Park Service notes that shuttle service varies by season and departure point and requires checking reservations. Other transit options involve mountain hiking. To see the redwoods, first check seasonal shuttles and return options on the NPS Directions page, then consider making it a separate day. Don't add it spontaneously after lunch in Sausalito.
返程前，给变动留一个出口: Leave room for changes on the return trip
出发当天再次查看所选渡轮的服务提醒，保存去回程页面，分清出发与到达时间。: Check your ferry operator's service alerts again that day. Save both outbound and return pages and distinguish departure from arrival times.
把码头设成返程导航终点，不以餐厅或停车场名称代替候船位置。: Set the ferry terminal as your return navigation destination. A restaurant or parking lot name is not a substitute for the boarding location.
海边带防风衣、水和充电设备；带小孩、长者或轮椅时，提前问运营商登船协助。: Bring a windproof layer, water, and charging gear for the waterfront. If traveling with children, older adults, or a wheelchair user, ask the operator about boarding assistance in advance.
发现误船或停航时先查官方后续安排，不边走边赌还有临时加班船。: If you miss a ferry or service is canceled, check the operator's next steps instead of walking on and betting on an extra sailing.
若需要陆路接送，明确上车位置、人数、行李和时间，确认费用后再约；不要默认有人即时: For a pickup by road, specify the pickup point, passengers, luggage, and time, and confirm the price before booking. Don't assume someone will respond immediately.
下午不一定要继续增加景点。找一个能看见水面的地方坐下，确认返程后再慢慢往码头走，: You don't have to add more sights in the afternoon. Find a seat with a water view, confirm your return trip, and walk back to the dock at an easy pace. That usually suits a car-free outing better than rushing. Save unfinished stops for next time; there is no need to force the itinerary together with an unplanned taxi ride.
